name: Andaz Bali
positioning: Beachfront resort in Sanur, designed as a modern interpretation of a Balinese village, with rooms, suites and villas around courtyards
best_for: Travelers who want a villa with a private garden pool
Families wanting a kids club and villas that connect for larger groups

facts.text: Andaz Bali is a beachfront resort in Sanur.
The resort is designed as a modern interpretation of a Balinese village.
The resort was built around the natural landscape.
Rooms, suites and villas are spread around clusters of courtyards.
Rooms and suites have a spacious balcony.
Lagoon Access rooms lead to the lagoon pool.
Garden Pool Villas blend traditional Balinese craftsmanship with contemporary touches.
Village Square, in the heart of the resort, has four intertwining restaurants.
Fisherman's Club is a beachfront restaurant serving the catch of the day from local fishermen, grilled on coconut husks the traditional way.
The resort has a kids club called Kemu Mai.
The resort has a Sea Turtle Village Conservation Program.

highlights.text: Garden Pool Villas have a private garden with a pool.
The two-bedroom Beach Pool Villa is steps from the beach.
The Beach Pool Villa can be connected to the Beach Villa next door to create a four-bedroom villa.
Villa stays include personalized butler service.

considerations.text: Ngurah Rai International Airport is about 14.6 kilometers away.
WhataHotel notes limited nightlife options in the surrounding Sanur area.
